Anya: Heads-up: starting ~2026-04-14T09:12Z we saw a cluster roll of gpu nodes in ap-southeast-1 fail to pull container images and stall on kubejoin. Failure rate ~22% across the new batch.
Ben: Any network errors in the pod logs?
Anya: Yes, firewall logs show a recent tighten of egress L7 rules for the control-plane VPC at 09:00Z. A bunch of STS/KMS calls and s3 GETs are getting REJECT/403 from the proxy. Sample: 
```
2026-04-14T09:13:05Z firewall-proxy denied tcp 10.0.20.55:443 -> sts.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com:443 (rule 8243 tightened)
2026-04-14T09:13:07Z kubelet: failed to GET image manifest: Get "https://s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-images/gpu:latest": net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded)
2026-04-14T09:13:07Z aws-kms: error GetCallerIdentity failed: access denied
```
Riley: So this is a policy change at the firewall layer, not a KMS/keystore rollout. Who merged that rule?
Sam: That was the egress-hardening change from yesterday's infra-security sprint - aimed to restrict external control-plane access. Looks like we accidentally blocked service endpoints used by bootstrap flows.
Tracey: Impact summary: 1) nodes can't pull images -> prolonged startup -> autoscaler thinks nodes unhealthy -> capacity shortfall for GPU pools 2) nodes can't call STS/KMS -> no IAM token exchange -> container creds fail 3) audit-shipper spikes when retries happen, compounding egress.
Ben: Quick mitigations we can do now: a) rollback the firewall rule (fast) b) open scoped allowlist for aws service endpoints (STS, KMS, S3) from control-plane subnets c) create VPC endpoints (PrivateLink) for S3/KMS/STS to avoid internet egress (takes longer) d) relax NACL/timeouts temporarily. Thoughts?
Anya: Rollback is fastest. But security might resist. Scoped allowlist is the middle ground and safer. PrivateLink is best long-term.
Riley: Cost/time estimates: PrivateLink endpoints ~ $0.6/hr per endpoint + data processing; initial work ~ 2-4hrs infra effort. Rollback ~ 15m and immediate. Whitelist increases egress surface slightly but negligible cost.
Sam: Also note S3 image pulls hit signing STS calls; whitelisting only S3 might not be enough - need STS and KMS for encrypted images.
Tracey: Proposed plan: 1) rollback rule to restore capacity (<=15m) 2) open scoped allowlist for svc endpoints and add ci: role-based exceptions (30m) 3) queue PrivateLink tickets ENGINFRA-9180 (S3/STS/KMS endpoints in ap-southeast-1) 4) update firewall runbook. We should also add metric firewall.egress.denied_by_rule to catch regressions.
Anya: I can rollback now. Who approves immediate rollback vs scoped allowlist?
Ben: I approve rollback for 30m to buy time for scoped allowlist. Notify security.
infra-bot: rollback executed by Anya at 09:21Z: firewall rule 8243 reverted.
Anya: After rollback, image pull failures dropped to <1% and kubejoin success normalized. KMS/ST S calls resumed. Audit-shipper retries reduced.
Riley: Follow-ups: - ENGINFRA-9180 PrivateLink endpoints (owner: Ben) - ENGINSEC-3456 change control to include service endpoint smoke tests before firewall hardening (owner: Tracey) - ENGINFRA-9181 add firewall.egress.denied_by_rule alert (owner: Riley) - ENGINFRA-9182: audit cost impact analysis for canary rollback/allowlist.
Sam: Cost estimate for rollback path: near-zero (just ops time). Scoped allowlist negligible. PrivateLink initial monthly baseline ~$450 + egress/data processing unknown. We'll draft numbers in ENGINFRA-9182.
Tracey: Also a policy change: require a small integration test that runs STS/KMS/S3 smoke calls from a control-plane canary before any egress tighten merges. I'll draft RFC.
Anya: PRs/links: rollback audit log https://git.redwood/infra/firewall/pull/667 (revert). Scoped allowlist PR in progress: https://git.redwood/infra/firewall/pull/668.
Ben: Charging incident ops to cover any emergency PrivateLink proof-of-concept cost. Keep cap at $3k.
Riley: Updated runbook note: "egress hardening smoke test -> verify STS/KMS/S3 operations from control-plane canary".
Anya: marking thread resolved after ENGINFRA-9180 ticket created and PR 668 merged. Thanks all :thumbsup:
